reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Dynamics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're thrilled to share the latest improvements to our water system in Provincia! Our new native sparse cellular automata (CA) keeps ponds inexpensive and ensures smooth flow dynamics. You can now dig, raise terrain, and activate wells without freezing the frame. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Dynamics in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to share significant updates to the water system in Provincia. With our latest changes, terrain shaping is smoother, and activating wells no longer causes frame freezes. For a deeper dive into the changes, check out our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
